concept.title: Courier Across the Dune Sea
concept.logline: On sunlit, melancholy Vimorqadir, you race to recover the sun shards and restore the Watchtower.
concept.source_prompt: Dune Sea. desert dunes dune sand mission Courier run
concept.player_fantasy: You are a wanderer who arrives at Oasis Market and becomes the one who brings the Watchtower back to life.

key_locations.name: Oasis Market
key_locations.description: The start: Oasis Market, where every trail of the gauntlet run begins.

key_locations.name: Nomad Camp
key_locations.description: Nomad Camp: a camp on the way out from Oasis Market.

key_locations.name: Buried Palace
key_locations.description: Buried Palace: a ruin on the way out from Oasis Market.

key_locations.name: Sand-buried Colossus
key_locations.description: Sand-buried Colossus: a landmark on the way out from Oasis Market.

key_locations.name: Watchtower
key_locations.description: Watchtower: the far end of the gauntlet run, where the story ends.

characters.name: Caravan Master Kai
characters.description: Waits in Oasis Market and knows why the Watchtower fell silent.

characters.name: Isla the Guide
characters.description: Follows you from Oasis Market and points out anything glinting nearby.

characters.name: Dune Stalker
characters.description: A dune stalker that prowls near its lair and runs down whatever it spots.

characters.name: Sandglass Sentinel
characters.description: A sandglass sentinel that walks the same beat over and over. Learn the loop and slip past.

characters.name: Corin the Trader
characters.description: Trades gossip about Vimorqadir for anything shiny.

characters.name: Sand Hopper
characters.description: A harmless sand hopper that bolts if you come too close.

objectives_outline: Deliver each one to its recipient
Report back before time runs out
hazards: Dune Stalker hunting near its lair
Sandglass Sentinel patrolling a fixed loop

actions.value: On sunlit, melancholy Vimorqadir, you race to recover the sun shards and restore the Watchtower.
4 parcels, one clock. Pick each one up and get it where it belongs.
Delivered: the Nomad Camp Relic is with Corin the Trader.
Delivered: the Buried Palace Relic is with Sand Hopper.

You are badly hurt. Back off and recover.

nodes.speaker: Caravan Master Kai
nodes.text: So you've come to Oasis Market at last. I am Caravan Master Kai. On sunlit, melancholy Vimorqadir, you race to recover the sun shards and restore the Watchtower.

choices.text: What do you need from me?

nodes.speaker: Caravan Master Kai
nodes.text: Back again. Oasis Market is quieter while you're out there.

nodes.speaker: Caravan Master Kai
nodes.text: Go to Nomad Camp, then Buried Palace. Whatever still remembers Courier Across the Dune Sea is out there. Bring it back to me.

nodes.speaker: Caravan Master Kai
nodes.text: They say Oasis Market was built on what was left of an older place. Lonely, even then. Ask the stones and they won't argue.

nodes.speaker: Caravan Master Kai
nodes.text: Nomad Camp: Nomad Camp: a camp on the way out from Oasis Market.

nodes.speaker: Caravan Master Kai
nodes.text: You found something out there. I can see it on you. That's one piece of Courier Across the Dune Sea back where it belongs.

nodes.speaker: Caravan Master Kai
nodes.text: Buried Palace: Buried Palace: a ruin on the way out from Oasis Market.

nodes.speaker: Isla the Guide
nodes.text: Isla the Guide circles your feet, then looks toward Sand-buried Colossus as if it already knows the way.

nodes.speaker: Isla the Guide
nodes.text: Isla the Guide sniffs the air. Something about Sand-buried Colossus has it restless.

nodes.speaker: Isla the Guide
nodes.text: It turns toward Sand-buried Colossus. Sand-buried Colossus: a landmark on the way out from Oasis Market.

nodes.speaker: Dune Stalker
nodes.text: The dune stalker watches you, low and still. It is not going to talk.

nodes.speaker: Corin the Trader
nodes.text: Welcome to my corner of Oasis Market. Corin the Trader's wares have come a long way to get here.

nodes.speaker: Corin the Trader
nodes.text: Rope, oil, dried fruit, and maps of Courier Across the Dune Sea that are only a little wrong. Nothing you can't find for yourself, if you're patient.

nodes.speaker: Corin the Trader
nodes.text: People say lights move at Nomad Camp after dark. I don't go there myself.

nodes.speaker: Sand Hopper
nodes.text: The sand hopper freezes, watches you with one bright eye, and looks ready to bolt.
